title: Defendable Receipt v0.1
description: Starter public schema for proof records emitted by Defendable-compatible routers, workers, datasets, policy engines, and agent runtimes.

receipt_id.description: Stable receipt identifier. Implementations should use collision-resistant IDs.

subject.description: Actor, agent, member, worker, or system that produced or caused the event.

policy.description: Policy pack, rules, controls, or review requirements evaluated for this action.

inputs.description: Datasets, prompts, tools, models, job parameters, or other material inputs.

outcome.description: Result, decision, status transition, cost, artifact URI, or failure state.

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of canonical receipt JSON excluding checksum_sha256.
